name: pika-labs/pika-h3-flex
title: Pika releases H3 Flex open weights: six-step video with synced audio on MiniMax-H3
summary: Pika H3 Flex ships as two LoRA adapters (text/frame and multi-reference) on the MiniMax-H3 base, generating 5 to 15 s of 480p or 768p video with stereo audio in six steps. Day-0 Diffusers and ComfyUI support; tested locally on an H100 80GB, with 1080p to 4K through Pika's paid API.
